CHAPTER.VERS: Putting away therefore all wickedness, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
to whom coming, a living stone, rejected indeed of men, but with God elect, precious,
Because it is contained in Scripture, Look, I lay in Zion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: And he who believes on him will not be put to shame.
and, A stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense; for they stumble at the word, being disobedient: to which also they were appointed.
who in time past were no people, but now are the people of God: who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
Be subject to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether to the king, as supreme;
or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.
Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
For this is acceptable, if for conscience toward God a man endures griefs, suffering wrongfully.
who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered did not threaten; but delivered [himself] to him who judges righteously:
